## What does this change help someone do?

Describe the user or research problem and the outcome of this change.

## What changed?

Summarize the implementation, documentation, or data-contract changes.

## How was it checked?

List the commands, tests, examples, or manual checks you ran. If a relevant
check was not run, explain why.

## Research and data review

- [ ] No private, raw, licensed, or access-controlled data is included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and examples are documented where readers will find them.
- [ ] Correctness claims or evidence are updated when numerical behavior changes.
- [ ] Compatibility, privacy, disclosure-risk, and citation effects are described, or do not apply.

## Related work

Link related issues, discussions, ADRs, or releases.
